baseline_tests.note: Auth driver [sanctum] for guard [sanctum] is not defined — API corporate tests could not execute this run

diagnostic_result: 7 confirmed flaws (assertions against correct economic/policy behavior failed)

confirmed_flaws.title: amountDue() ignores discount_amount
confirmed_flaws.impact: Phantom residual; wrong deliver status; partner accrual skipped; PaymentModal blocked via isPaid()
confirmed_flaws.fix: amountDue() = max(0, total_amount - discount_amount - amount_paid) OR store net total_amount at checkout; align payment_status threshold with same formula

confirmed_flaws.title: deliverToConsumer uses amountDue()===0 so discounted paid orders stay delivered
confirmed_flaws.impact: Orders never reach delivered_and_paid; OrderMoneyFlow.accrueShares never runs
confirmed_flaws.fix: Branch on economic due (after F1) or payment_status/isFullySettled() helper

confirmed_flaws.title: Gateway residual counted as rider cash
confirmed_flaws.impact: Online money enters cash handovers; rider float / Middo cash double-count risk
confirmed_flaws.fix: Remove legacy prepaid_amount==0 branch OR require payment_method=cash_on_delivery / explicit cash_collected only; set prepaid_amount on gateway residual settle

confirmed_flaws.title: Partner commissions can exceed billNet
confirmed_flaws.impact: Guaranteed Middo loss on heavily commissioned / discounted menus
confirmed_flaws.fix: Cap/pro-rate partner shares to billNet; validate menu commissions at save; alert when kitchen+delivery > price

confirmed_flaws.title: Auto-grouper allows over-capacity solo groups
confirmed_flaws.impact: Kitchen batch size policy violated; ops planning assumptions break
confirmed_flaws.fix: Reject assignOrder when qty > max OR split order; keep daily corporate limit aligned

confirmed_flaws.title: Multi-date COD policy conflict
confirmed_flaws.evidence: allowsCashOnDelivery(false,2)=false but OrderCheckoutModal forces COD fallback (lines 903-904)
confirmed_flaws.impact: Multi-day carts unpaid at checkout without explicit COD eligibility
confirmed_flaws.fix: Either allow multi-date COD in helper + UI, or require balance/gateway for multi-date and remove forced COD fallback

confirmed_flaws.title: isPaid() true while amountDue()>0 blocks cash UI
confirmed_flaws.impact: Stuck delivered orders with uncollectable residual after coupon path
confirmed_flaws.fix: Fix F1; make isPaid() mean economic due==0; PaymentModal gate on amountDue() only

code_review_flaws.title: Package skip does not refund subscription charges_amount
code_review_flaws.evidence: PackageSubscriptionService skip refunds order.amount_paid (= day food only); charges stay on subscription
code_review_flaws.fix: Pro-rate charges into day orders at schedule, or refund unused charge share on skip/cancelRemaining

code_review_flaws.title: Ops can reassign/clear kitchen after pack without status/custody guards
code_review_flaws.evidence: AssignKitchenModal::save updates kitchen_id freely; only first assign advances pending→processing
code_review_flaws.fix: Block reassignment when any member is packed/dispatched/in transit; or require box return first

code_review_flaws.title: cancelRemaining can mark subscription cancelled while past-cutoff days remain live
code_review_flaws.fix: Use status=active_partial / completed_partial, or only cancel when no locked live days remain

code_review_flaws.title: Gateway-prepaid cancel refunds wallet, not original tender
code_review_flaws.fix: Gateway reverse for gateway pays; wallet credit only for balance pays

code_review_flaws.title: Coupon quote uses food subtotal; redeem allocates across food+fees cart
code_review_flaws.evidence: OrderCheckoutModal::applyCoupon quotes round(subtotal); line totals include fees
code_review_flaws.fix: Quote and redeem on the same base (prefer payable cart = food+fees)

code_review_flaws.title: Sanctum guard driver not registered in test/runtime
code_review_flaws.evidence: 16 API tests error: Auth driver [sanctum] for guard [sanctum] is not defined
code_review_flaws.fix: Ensure Laravel\Sanctum\SanctumServiceProvider is discovered; or use auth:sanctum with web guard tokens and remove custom sanctum driver guard if unsupported
